d:
Andhalgaon Silk Saree
Background:
In earlier days, handloom weavers of village Andhalgaon, Mohadi
and Palandur District Bhandara, the part of Vidarbha region in
Maharashtra used to produce cotton gamchha with 20s cotton yarn
in warp and weft having two side Karvati border (Solid border).
“Karvat” in Marathi is the saw and since the designs look like saw
tooth, the fabric is known as Karvati or Karvatkati. District
